svg.title: Codestz — hermit, apprentice — a MainQuest character sheet derived from public GitHub activity
svg.desc: Class from the shape of contribution activity, not its volume. Sigil is generated from the login and never changes.
svg.metadata: Heraldic charge "layered-armor" by lorc from game-icons.net (https://game-icons.net), licensed CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Recoloured and composited into a heraldic sigil by MainQuest.

g.text: Steady damage spread across the whole campaign.
Strike several targets at once, at reduced focus.
Finisher. Turns an open PR into something already in main.
Recover vigour while the streak holds. Breaks on the first empty day.
